text:
maya (Console): quick q — when we fall back (route to small model / different region) what should the client see? consistent messaging across SDKs + console needed

arjun (API): agreed we need a clear contract. my gut: keep 429 for client-driven quota, 503 for infra/capacity fallbacks. but we should include machine-readable hints for UX + retry logic

kate (Platform): +1 but we also want to avoid apps surfacing raw 503 to end-users. suggest header like `X-Redwood-Hint` with a short token and optional params so SDKs/console can surface a friendly badge

tom (SRE): practical note: many clients currently auto-retry on 5xx. fallback -> we sometimes want silent degrade (no retry) not spike traffic. header should include `retryable=true|false`

arjun (API): sketch of header I threw together: 
```
X-Redwood-Hint: fallback=routed_to=small-variant;reason=capacity;retryable=false
X-Redwood-Client: quota=exceeded;retry_after=12
```
this keeps semantics separate: quota vs routing fallback

maya (Console): nice. console could show a little pill: "Routed to small variant — higher latency, cheaper" and an alert if `retryable=true`

kate (Platform): we should avoid too many bespoke strings. propose canonical hint keys: `fallback`, `quota`, `throttle`, `region`. values are short tokens. e.g. `fallback=small_v2;reason=capacity;retryable=false`

tom (SRE): +1 on canonical keys. also we need telemetry mapping. event fields: `error_bucket`, `hint_kind`, `fallback_target`, `retryable`, `client_id`, `route_policy` so we can dashboard quick filters

arjun (API): telemetry event example: 
```json
{"error_bucket":"infra.fallback","hint_kind":"fallback","fallback_target":"small_v2","retryable":false}
```
we can emit that alongside normal error counters

maya (Console): for the console UX: show a trend line for `infra.fallback` and let users click to see example requests + hint header sample. tooltip: "This means requests were routed to a smaller model due to capacity policy"

kate (Platform): rollout plan: 1) add header + telemetry in API layer 2) SDKs read header and expose structured object 3) console surfaces badge and alert 4) docs + sample copy. We should also define the mapping table in an RFC

arjun (API): one tricky point: some customers use our proxies and strip headers. we should also include a JSON body hint for SDK consumers when content-type=application/json, e.g. `{\"rw_hint\":{...}}` but only for SDKs we control — otherwise headers preferred

tom (SRE): ops/beta: add rate-limited logs for hint emission. we don't want to spam logs when fallback is noisy

maya (Console): copy suggestions for client-facing text: short variants: 
- quota -> "Request limit reached. Try again in %s seconds."
- fallback -> "Serving with alternative model due to capacity; results may differ."
- throttle -> "Temporarily reduced throughput; retryable."

kate (Platform): also decide status code policy in RFC: 
- 429 + X-Redwood-Client for strict quota enforcement
- 503 + X-Redwood-Hint(fallback) for infra routing fallback (retryable flag may be true/false)
- 200 + X-Redwood-Hint(info) when degraded but still served (no error)

arjun (API): that last line is important — not all fallbacks are errors. returning 200 with a hint for degraded model avoids client confusion and keeps logs cleaner

maya (Console): UX question: when 200+hint(degraded) should console mark as warning or ok? I vote warning with sample diff view (show likely differences if we can estimate)

tom (SRE): telemetry needs to count 3 buckets separately: `client_quota`, `infra_fallback_error` (5xx), `degraded_served` (200+hint). gives clean SLO dashboards

kate (Platform): action items: 
- arjun: draft header + telemetry spec (proto + examples) 
- maya: console mockups for 200+hint and 503+hint flows 
- tom: logging/alert thresholds for noisy fallbacks 
- I'll own RFC and rollout checklist

arjun (API): I'll put a PR for header emit in the API gateway next week. sample code in SDKs to parse will follow

maya (Console): thanks — I'll mock quick copy + badge states and drop screenshots in the RFC thread :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-notify: api-gateway v3.14 deployed to staging (no hint headers enabled by default)

kate (Platform): perfect — let's keep the header opt-in in staging until we finalize canonical tokens. will spin up a tiny doc for mapping tokens -> console copy

maya (Console): sgtm. tagging @arjun @tom for visibility.
